name: characteristic-voice
title_zh: 给语音加呼吸感、语气词和情绪起伏的拟人化调音师
tagline_zh: 嫌 TTS 像客服？它给合成语音注入停顿、语气词和情绪曲线，让晚安、安慰、撒娇都像真人开口，而非机器念稿。
tagline_en: TTS sounds like a robot? This adds pauses, fillers, and emotional arcs so goodnights, comfort, and teasing feel.
desc_en: Use this skill whenever the user wants speech to sound more human, companion-like, or emotionally expressive. Triggers include: any mention of 'say like', 'talk like', 'speak like', 'companion voice', 'comfort me', 'cheer me up', 'sound more human', 'good night voice', 'good morning voice', or requests to add fillers, emotion, or personality to generated speech. Also use when the user wants to mim
why_zh: 不靠音高抖动糊弄，而是从语料里学真人停顿和填充词的位置，按场景重排节奏，让情绪落在对的地方。
why_en: No fake pitch wobble—it learns where real speakers pause and insert fillers, then re-times the rhythm so emotion lands naturally.
limit_zh: 只处理文本到语音的韵律层，不生成音频也不改音色；需要你已有 TTS 引擎或音频文件；对超过 3 分钟的独白可能节奏拖沓。
limit_en: Only reshapes prosody on text; no audio generation or voice timbre change. Needs your TTS engine or audio file. Over 3-min monologues may drag.
